source: Lovable design lab; not canonical GitHub

lines.content: Compatible UI-only port: compact navy sidebar/mini state, topbar and mobile drawer presentation; theme roles inherited from `.cx` and staff `.sx` layout; `StaffRoute`, icon-and-text `StaffStatus`, `StaffSurface`; bounded semantic table with status filtering, detail panel, timeline, immutable sent-Quote notice, payment-proof/Finance-confirmation distinction, grant-gated empty bank-settings presentation and explicit high-authority confirmation layout. Copy is independent AR/EN in `staff-content.ts`. Adapt these visuals to canonical Next.js actions, effective grants, immutable Quote data, tenant/Market scope and private file access.

Reject during Codex port: `staff-concept.ts` role presets and all `demo*` predicates, role/grant selectors, synthetic LAB queue generation, surface/Quote/payment selectors, preview notices and acknowledgement-only confirmation handlers, in-memory navigation, this TanStack route/runtime and theme-preference wiring. SUPER_ADMIN is not a role-name bypass; its actual effective grants must come from canonical authorization. Confirmation only displays a notice and never changes payment/Quote/execution state. No file upload/download, account edit, driver assignment or backend command exists here. Preserve all 47 migrations and all canonical business rules. No publishing or integration was performed.

Port presentation only: `.dx` layout on `.cx` theme roles, safety note, trip card, labelled display slots, stop hierarchy with cyan nodes, single next-action panel (pending/unconfirmed/disabled), location status banner, issue form (PNG/JPEG evidence), POD form with white signature substrate + file alternative, read-only redacted history. Reject: review state selector, `driver-concept.ts` state lists as authority, theme/market/locale wiring, this route/runtime. No trips, GPS, ETA, offline queue, command handlers or success simulation exist.
- [x] Verify illustrative role boundaries, immutable sent quotes and separate bank-settings grant with tests.
- [x] Verify states, confirmations, keyboard/mobile drawer and 360/390/768/1280/1440 layouts.
- [x] Document compatible visual components and reject demo/runtime wiring for Codex port.
- [x] Driver preview: assigned trips, trip/stop detail, single next action, issue form, POD, read-only history, location and states; labelled display slots instead of data.
